reason: The hypothesis combines the W-Ta-Cr-V RHEA system (P1, P2) with the concept of coherent oxide nanoprecipitates for radiation tolerance (P8, P31) and mechanical strength (P20, P28). This specific combination is not proposed in any single passage; P1 and P2 study a quinary RHEA without intentional oxides, while P8 and P31 study ODS-W, not RHEAs. The hypothesis thus synthesizes two separate lines of work into a new material design.
